text.p: Typhoon Nestor continue to track near Iwo Jima with top winds up to 130 mph. It should weaken slightly as it tracks by Chichi Jima in about 12 hours. These islands can expect heavy rains leading to flooding. Damaging winds are also likely. In addition shipping will be impacted due to seas in excess of 20 feet and due to very strong winds. It is expected to turn northeast and track east of Japan in 24-36 hours. It will become extratropical later in this period. It is expected to pass east of Honshu Japan during this period but it does bear watching.
Tropical Depression Blanca has dissipated and is no longer considered a risk to shipping.

Tropical Cyclone Keli, with 90 mph winds, is in the southern Pacific near 10s/179.5e, moving east-northeast at 4 mph. Keli has reached peak intensity and will slowly weaken over the next 48 hours. It is expected to turn back towards the south during this period. It is mostly a risk to shipping during the period.
